name: Alta Vista
title: Alta Vista Window Cleaning in Lakeway, Spot Free | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Alta Vista homes in the center of Lakeway near Lohmans Crossing. Short drive, flexible booking, outside windows $10 each. Text us.
intro: Alta Vista wraps around the center of Lakeway, close to Lohmans Crossing and daily errands. CleanzATX is based in the same town, so this is some of our shortest driving.

sections.h2: What Alta Vista homes are like
paragraphs: Alta Vista sits in the heart of Lakeway with several hundred homes and an active HOA. Prices run from about $500K to $900K, a more approachable range for the area. The neighborhood is not gated. Because it surrounds the town center, residents are a short drive from groceries, restaurants and the lake.

Homes here are a mix of ages and sizes. Some owners have been in place for years and others have moved in recently, so you find both original windows and newer replacements. Lots are mid sized, with trees that have had time to mature.

sections.h2: What Alta Vista windows deal with
paragraphs: Central Lakeway means traffic dust and road grime settling on street facing glass. Trees add pollen, and live oak sheds heavily in March and April. Cedar pollen arrives from December to February. Sprinkler spray on lawns hits windows near the ground and leaves white hard water spots.

Screens collect leaf bits, and tracks collect spider webs and dirt. Neglected tracks make windows harder to open. Our pure water system, near 0 TDS, leaves glass free of soap film, and track cleaning is $5 when you want it done.

With no gate, scheduling is quick. We drive in, set up a pole system and clean exterior glass from the ground. Interior windows are done by hand with squeegees and drop cloths. Alta Vista is near the middle of Lakeway, so when we work nearby neighborhoods on the same day, we cluster visits to save you time. Gutters and house wash often pair well with windows in these mid sized homes.
Take a 2,800 square foot home as an example. Exterior windows run about $280 at $0.10 per square foot, with roughly two and a half hours outside. Add about 85 minutes for interior glass.

why: Central Lakeway location means short drive time and flexible booking.
Street facing glass cleaned of road dust without harsh soap.
Tracks and screens cleaned to remove webs and leaf litter.
Mid sized homes land near our typical price, with no surprises.

faq.q: Do you work in Alta Vista often?
faq.a: Yes. It is in the center of Lakeway, close to where we are based. New jobs are usually scheduled within about two weeks.

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Text (512) 518-0512 with your address and a rough number of windows. We reply by text, usually within the hour during business hours.

faq.q: Can you clean tracks and screens?
faq.a: Yes. Screens are $5 each and tracks are $5. Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans include one free screen cleaning each year.

faq.q: What if it rains after you clean?
faq.a: On Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans, the 7 day rain guarantee covers a recleaning. Every job also includes a 7 day touch up when you send a photo.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Not for exterior work, if we can reach the windows and any gate. For interior cleaning we need access to the house. Tell us what works when you text.
